quality_effect: Pins EA 1m DTM lineage, survey epoch and resampling behavior before candidate elevation sampling.
verified_facts: Composite DTM covers about 99% of England at 1m resolution
DTM represents terrain after surface-object removal
2022 composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
Newest best-resolution survey is used where repeat surveys exist
Bilinear interpolation is used where data is resampled
Composite contains surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
Metadata catalogues identify the source survey used per location
A WCS service is advertised for the 1m DTM
